# The hall

## Narration

The hall is dark, and the lantern that lit the gate (`[[scene:the-gate]]`)
is now the only light left in the yard. `[[rule:D1]]` says it will not burn on
the ground.

## Dialog

@[[character:ada]] "There is nothing here."

@warden "Then we wait."

## Narration

Ada sets the lantern down and waits for the warden to speak.
